title: Psalms Bible Quiz - Chapter 49
description: Ten questions on Psalms 49: riches cannot ransom a life, death shepherds the foolish to Sheol, but God will redeem the psalmist's soul.

questions.text: According to verse 2, who are called to listen together?
questions.explanation: Psalms 49:1-2 calls all peoples to listen, "both low and high, rich and poor together."

answers.text: Low and high, rich and poor

questions.text: On what instrument will the psalmist solve his riddle?
questions.explanation: Psalms 49:4 says, "I will solve my riddle on the harp."

questions.text: Those who trust in their wealth cannot by any means redeem whom?
questions.explanation: Psalms 49:6-7 says none of those who trust in their wealth can by any means redeem his brother, nor give God a ransom for him.

questions.text: What does verse 8 say about payment for the redemption of a life?
questions.explanation: Psalms 49:8 says, "For the redemption of their life is costly, no payment is ever enough."

answers.text: A gift to the temple is enough

questions.text: According to verse 10, what happens to wise men?
questions.explanation: Psalms 49:10 says, "For he sees that wise men die."

questions.text: What do the rich name after themselves, according to verse 11?
questions.explanation: Psalms 49:11 says, "They name their lands after themselves."

questions.text: Verse 12 says that man, despite his riches, is like what?
questions.explanation: Psalms 49:12 says, "But man, despite his riches, doesn't endure. He is like the animals that perish."

questions.text: Who shall be the shepherd of the foolish, according to verse 14?
questions.explanation: Psalms 49:14 says, "They are appointed as a flock for Sheol. Death shall be their shepherd."

questions.text: From the power of what will God redeem the psalmist's soul?
questions.explanation: Psalms 49:15 says, "But God will redeem my soul from the power of Sheol, for he will receive me."

questions.text: What will a rich man carry away when he dies?
questions.explanation: Psalms 49:17 says, "For when he dies he will carry nothing away."
